title: Police chief condemns ‘terrifying’ Bonfire Night violence across Scotland
summary_full: Multiple arrests, emergency services targeted and police van set alight while disorder also erupts in north-east EnglandA police chief has condemned the “unacceptable and terrifying” Bonfire Night disorder that resulted in seven arrests, a police van being torched and an officer and a paramedic being injured in Scotland.Ch Supt David Robertson of Police Scotland said there had been significant reduction in problems overall, compared with 2025, after the force deployed its largest number of officers since Donald Trump’s visit last year.
